item.description: The Ole Miss Athletic Department brought in $178.6 million total revenue, netting a loss after over $183.7 million in operating expenses this past year. item.description: As tree limbs crashed onto powerlines throughout the night of Jan. 24, the temperature in thousands of Lafayette County homes fell.
